description: What the panel needs, which is less than either window. It is shown, placed, resized and put away from Rust — the key that opens it is heard while another application is in front, so none of that can depend on a webview being there to ask — and the commands that do it are this application's own rather than a plugin's, so they need no permission here. `core:default` and nothing else: it drags no title bar, opens no dialog, holds no memory session and reveals itself through none of the window commands the project window is granted.
